# pbs_sync_jobs (Data Source)

Lists the sync jobs of a Proxmox Backup Server, pulls and pushes alike, with the attributes of `pbs_sync_job`: those the provider's user or token may read, with `Datastore.Audit` on the job's `store`, and `Remote.Audit` on `/remote/<remote>` for a pull, `Datastore.Audit` on `remote_store` for a local pull, or `Remote.Audit` on `/remote/<remote>/<remote_store>` for a push; PBS leaves the others out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The push jobs of store1: where its backups are copied to.
data "pbs_sync_jobs" "store1_pushes" {
  store          = "store1"
  sync_direction = "push"
}

output "store1_copies" {
  value = [for j in data.pbs_sync_jobs.store1_pushes.jobs : "${j.remote}:${j.remote_store}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `store` (String) List only the jobs of this datastore, such as `store1`: those whose `store` it is.
- `sync_direction` (String) List only the jobs of this direction, `pull` or `push`; both when left out.

### Read-Only

- `jobs` (Attributes List) The sync jobs, sorted by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))

<a id="nestedatt--jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jobs`

Read-Only:

- `burst_in` (String) How many bytes over `rate_in` the job may receive at once, as PBS writes it, such as `10 MiB`; null for no limit.
- `burst_out` (String) How many bytes over `rate_out` the job may send at once, as PBS writes it, such as `10 MiB`; null for no limit.
- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `encrypted_only` (Boolean) Whether the job copies only encrypted backups.
- `group_filter` (Set of String) Which backup groups the job syncs; null for all of them.
- `id` (String) Job ID, such as `pull-offsite`.
- `max_depth` (Number) How many levels of namespaces below the source namespace the job syncs too; null for all of them.
- `ns` (String) Namespace in `store`; null for the datastore's root namespace.
- `owner` (String) User or API token the job acts as; null for `root@pam`.
- `rate_in` (String) Rate limit on what the job receives, in bytes per second, as PBS writes it, such as `10 MiB`; null for no limit.
- `rate_out` (String) Rate limit on what the job sends, in bytes per second, as PBS writes it, such as `10 MiB`; null for no limit.
- `remote` (String) Name of the remote; null for a local pull.
- `remote_ns` (String) Namespace in `remote_store`; null for its root namespace.
- `remote_store` (String) Datastore on the remote, or the local datastore a local pull copies from.
- `remove_vanished` (Boolean) Whether the job deletes from the target what the source no longer has.
- `resync_corrupt` (Boolean) Whether a pull copies again the backups whose local copy failed verification.
- `run_on_mount` (Boolean) Whether the job runs when a removable datastore it syncs with is mounted.
- `schedule` (String) When the job runs, as a PBS calendar event; null when it runs only when started by hand or mounted.
- `store` (String) Local datastore: the target of a pull, the source of a push.
- `sync_direction` (String) `pull` or `push`.
- `transfer_last` (Number) How many of the most recent backups of each group the job copies; null for all.
- `unmount_on_done` (Boolean) Whether PBS unmounts the removable datastore after a run its mount started.
- `verified_only` (Boolean) Whether the job copies only verified backups.
- `worker_threads` (Number) How many backup groups the job syncs at the same time; null for one at a time.
